page.title: AI consultant vs automation agency companies
page.description: Compare AI consultants and automation agencies on problems solved, pricing, deliverables, engagement fit and hidden dependencies.
page.h1: How do you decide on AI consultant vs automation agency companies?
page.definition: AI consultant vs automation agency companies are service providers that help organizations adopt artificial intelligence; consultants deliver assessments, use‑case prioritisation, tool selection and roadmaps while agencies build working automations, integrations and documentation often backed by a support retainer for ongoing maintenance and scaling.
page.quick_answer: Choose a consultant when you need a strategic roadmap and tool evaluation; choose an agency when you need ready‑to‑run automations and ongoing support.

sections.h2: What problems does each type solve?

blocks.p: Consultants focus on strategy, assessment and roadmap creation while agencies focus on building and maintaining operational automations.

ul: Consultant delivers an AI maturity assessment
Consultant produces a prioritized use‑case list
Consultant recommends a tool stack and implementation roadmap
Agency delivers working automation scripts and integrations
Agency provides documentation and hand‑off guides
Agency offers a support retainer for monitoring and updates

blocks.p: Consultants typically charge a day rate or a fixed project fee while agencies charge a fixed build fee plus a monthly retainer.

sections.h2: Which engagement model fits your team size?

blocks.p: Small teams often benefit from a consultant’s lightweight assessment while larger teams with existing workflows may need an agency’s build capacity and retainer.

sections.h2: How to evaluate hidden dependencies before signing?

blocks.p: Identify data access, compliance, change‑management and vendor lock‑in risks early to avoid surprise costs later.

ul: Confirm data ownership and export rights
Map regulatory requirements to automation scope
Review vendor API stability and deprecation policy
Define escalation paths for production incidents

faq.q: How do I know if I need a consultant or an agency?
faq.a: If you lack a clear AI strategy and need help selecting tools, a consultant provides an assessment and roadmap; if you already know the use cases and want production‑ready workflows, an agency delivers built automations and a support retainer for ongoing maintenance.

faq.q: What should I ask during the first meeting?
faq.a: Ask for a sample assessment, a list of prioritized use cases, the recommended tool stack, a timeline with milestones, and the pricing structure; also request references for similar projects and clarify who owns the final automation code and documentation for future updates.

faq.q: How long does a typical engagement last?
faq.a: A consultant engagement usually spans a few weeks for discovery and roadmap delivery; an agency build phase can take several weeks to months depending on complexity, followed by a monthly retainer for monitoring and improvements and scaling over time as needs evolve.
